annotations.title: Create or upload the Android upload key

description: Gives Ploa this app's Android upload key, which it keeps in its vault and signs every Android build with; it never leaves Ploa. how create: Ploa makes a new key (RSA 2048, valid 30 years) right in the vault, so no one holds a copy and no password passes through you. Use it only when Google Play has no upload key for this app yet (a new app, or one never uploaded): Play takes the first build's key as the upload key. how upload: an existing keystore (.keystore, .jks or .p12 in PKCS#12 format) from an absolute path on this machine, with its password and, if it holds several keys, the alias. Use it when Play already knows an upload key, for example one EAS or Android Studio made; take the password from the person or where they keep it, never write it into a file. A key Ploa already holds is replaced only with replace: true, and only when the person asked for it, since Play rejects builds signed with a key it doesn't know. Only a person, or an agent its owner made autonomous (see ploa_access), may do this; the workspace's owners are told each time.

alias.description: how upload: the key's alias, if the keystore holds several.

dir.description: The app's folder (absolute path). Defaults to the folder the agent runs in.

path.description: how upload: absolute path to the keystore.

replace.description: Replace the upload key Ploa already holds. Only when the person asked.
